statement: Elixpo does not currently solicit, accept, hold, or route organization-level sponsorship funds.

projectOwnedFunding.statement: A project may publish its own funding route under its own authority and accounting. Listing the project through Elixpo does not make Elixpo the recipient, intermediary, guarantor, or endorser.

independence.selection: Funding does not purchase Chapter selection, Member Project status, or feature placement.
independence.research: Funding does not control research conclusions, review labels, or reproducibility records.
independence.credit: Funding does not purchase contributor credit or governance authority.
independence.editorial: Funding does not purchase favourable editorial treatment.

stickers.statement: The public site shows watermarked sticker previews only. Print-ready artwork or physical sticker packs are released only after Elixpo approves a non-monetary event partnership request in writing; viewing a preview does not grant permission to print or distribute it.

eventPartnerships.upTo100: Community-partner credit and a linked social mention are requested in exchange for the agreed pack or print-ready artwork.
eventPartnerships.over100: Community-partner credit and a linked social mention remain required, together with an on-stage Elixpo introduction of no more than ten minutes.
eventPartnerships.around200OrMore: Requires a written custom agreement. The ten-minute introduction remains; any additional visibility or venue space must be agreed before production.
requestRequirements: event identity, date, venue, organizer, and public page
delivery location, deadline, and printing responsibility
proposed social credit, brand placement, and speaking arrangement
named organizer responsible for confirming delivery and outcomes

requirements: public description of what support funds
approval recorded in the canonical policy
